observations: CI at head 5f77669b (build, changes, lint, test, typecheck) was queued when read; the runs at 247b43fd were cancelled when 5f77669b was pushed. Not waited for.
Round 1's proof entries below keep headSha 9cc3cd95: the server they exercised is unchanged at 5f77669b.

Statistics are as fresh as the last 10-minute refresh: a word written since then is probed and counts as df = 1 (plan decision 2), so right after a burst of filings a now-common word can be picked as rare. Before the 12:31 refresh 'Telemetry' (then in 30 issues) was chosen; after it, it was not.
A write whose write advice also times out takes the advice's ~1.5 s before the 5 s check (POST /api/v1/issues elapsed_ms 6518 with asks locked); the check itself stopped at 5000 ms.
A timed-out check's record is retried for 30 s; with asks locked for 40 s the CORE-52 record was lost and the server logged `related-item check not recorded … context deadline exceeded`.
